description: What this VAERS pack currently holds: total unique reports, the year range covered, how many distinct vaccine types and manufacturers, and when the seed was last (re)loaded — refresh is a manual re-download of the CDC/FDA data files, not a live feed, so check this before relying on recency. Also returns the top 5 vaccines by report volume as a starting point for vaers_events_by_vaccine.
